raw_ocr_excerpt:
As mentioned above, Teachnook in collaboration with IBM is organizing a 2
Month Training + Internship program designed by IBM. We are enrolling only
LIMITED STUDENTS for the program.

*Interested students fill the form, if you get shortlisted you will be
getting a call from our HR Team.*

*G Form : **https://forms.gle/ZVjfUuoe2URTFrif9
<https://forms.gle/ZVjfUuoe2URTFrif9>*

*📚 Training Program:- *Our comprehensive and immersive training program is
curated by industry professionals with over* 10 years *of work experience.
The program spans across *25-30 modules*, providing more than *60 hours* of
engaging content. We ensure that students have a solid foundation by
offering prerequisite classes, making them industry-ready.

*⚙️ Industrial Internship:- *To complement the training, students will gain
valuable practical experience through *10+ live projects*. These projects
present real-world challenges, allowing you to apply the skills learned
during the training. The internship's pinnacle is the *capstone project*,
integrated into the final week, where you will have the chance to showcase
all your acquired skills and knowledge.
Available courses ( Charges applicable ) :
✅Python with data science.
✅Data Visualization with R.
✅Deep learning with TensorFlow.
✅Data Analysis with Python.
✅Internet of Things.

After Completion of program the student shall receive a :
✅ Program completion certificate issued by IBM.
✅ Co-Branded Internship certificate.
✅ Letter of Recommendation from
